verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page states that users can optionally bring their online calendar, contacts and data to the desktop with online accounts, which matches the story's wording directly. The evidence is a single marketing line, with no detail on providers or setup and no community confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of supported account providers and sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can bring my online calendar, contacts, and data into the desktop with online account integration

citations.quote: Optionally, bring your online calendar, contacts and data to the desktop with online accounts.
